'ye prem mol liya' film 27 navanbar ko riliz huee hai. is film men aayushman khurana aur sharavri vagh mukhy bhumika men hain. is film ko suraj barjatya ne dayrekt kiya hai. dekhie suraj barjatya, aayushman khurana aur sharavri vagh ke sath stuti ghosh ki khas batchit.
